icons.action: Rebuke. Wick rebuking someone out of frame: one arm raised with the hand held flat and stiff toward them, like a stern "enough", and a single hard straight ray of light leaving the palm. His other hand is at his side. It must read as a scolding word that lands, not as casting a spell: no swirls, no sparks, no magic circle, one ray only. Match the attached Whisper icons: one small light source.

Both Hands. Wick fighting with a sword in one hand and a pistol in the other at the same moment: mid-strike with the blade swept across his body, the pistol in the other hand already levelled straight ahead. A grounded lunge, not a spin. The sword and pistol are simple invented shapes, not real-world models.

Order. Wick giving an order to a squadmate: standing square, one arm thrust out straight with the whole hand pointing "you, go there", mouth open in a shout shown by two short sound lines at his face. Commanding, not angry.
Rally. Wick rallying the squad: one fist raised high above his head, body leaning forward, three short sound lines fanning up from him. A cheer that lifts people.

Brief. Wick giving a quick briefing: crouched on one knee, one hand drawing a short plan on the ground with a finger (two small strokes and a dot on the ground line), the other hand held up with two fingers raised. Calm and quick.

Name It. Wick naming a fear out loud so it loses its hold: standing firm, one open hand held out palm-up as if presenting something, and in front of that hand a small jagged shape with a simple ring drawn around it, as if circled and labelled. Steady, reassuring.

Cue. Wick giving a cue: one arm raised with the hand about to drop in a sharp "now!" chop, a single short curved motion line under the hand, his head turned over his shoulder toward someone behind him.
Spot. Wick pointing out a target: one arm fully extended with a pointing finger, his other hand shading his eyes, and far along the pointing line a small target ring.
Warn. Wick shouting a warning: both hands cupped around his mouth, body twisted toward someone at his side, and a small sharp zig-zag danger mark above and behind him. Urgent.
Threaten. Wick threatening an enemy: leaning forward and looming, shoulders up, one hand drawn across in a slow cutting gesture at chest height, capelet flared. Menacing but still Wick. No weapon.
Taunt. Wick goading an enemy: weight on his back foot, one hand beckoning "come on then" with curled fingers, the other hand on his hip, head tilted. Cocky.
Rage: the ribbon snaps upward into a jagged crest, like a flame with teeth.
Grief: the ribbon falls and pools at the bottom like rain running off.
Fear: the ribbon recoils outward from an empty centre, in broken ring fragments.
Love: two ribbons wrap around each other into one knot.
Joy: the ribbon leaps in a high arc with a small spark at the peak.
Calm: one long level stroke over two or three still circles, like a horizon over water.

Spite: a hooked ribbon turning back on itself like a barb.
Shame: the ribbon folds inward and hides its own end.
Pride: the ribbon rises into a tall straight spire.
Despair: the ribbon unravels downward into loose threads.
Hope: a small flame-shaped ribbon rising from a low flat line.
Mercy: an open cupped curve, lowered, like a hand let down.
Cruelty: the ribbon tightens into a loop with thorns.
Loneliness: one small knot far from a wide empty ring.
Belonging: several small knots joined along one line.
Dread: the ribbon coils around an empty eye-shaped gap.
Awe: rays opening above a small bowed curve.
Longing: the ribbon reaches toward a distant dot and does not touch it.
Relief: a knot coming loose into a soft breath-like curl.
Contempt: the ribbon turned away with a lifted, chin-like tilt.
Guilt: the ribbon drags a small weight behind it.
Jealousy: two ribbons, one curling to snatch the other's spark.
Wonder: a spiral opening into a small star.
Defiance: the ribbon stands straight against slanted lines pushing at it.
Abandon: the ribbon flung wide, its knot burst open.
